movie.title: The Blind Side
movie.overview: The story of Michael Oher, a homeless and traumatized boy who became an All American football player and first round NFL draft pick with the help of a caring woman and her family.

facts: The movie 'The Blind Side' tells the incredible real-life story of Michael Oher, who began his journey as a homeless and traumatized young boy.
It's truly inspiring to learn that Michael Oher went on to become an All-American football player, showcasing immense talent and perseverance.
His story culminates in a major achievement: Michael Oher was ultimately chosen as a first-round NFL draft pick!
